ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean when it says 'you will be stones or iron' regarding resurrection?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Isra, this verse responds to the disbelievers' skepticism about resurrection by citing their own examples of inert matter—stone and iron—to demonstrate Allah's absolute power to recreate them. Shia exegetes, such as Allamah Tabatabai in *Al-Mizan*, interpret this as a rhetorical device affirming that just as Allah created these hard substances from nothing, He can easily resurrect them, thereby refuting the notion that physical hardness prevents revival.
